newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Piper Jaffray cuts Nordstrom.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Piper Jaffray cuts Nordstrom.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffray said Monday it had cut its rating on Nordstrom Inc to market performer from buy due to the retailer's announcement that it does not expect to meet fourth quarter earnings estimates.
-- Piper said it preliminarily cut its fourth quarter estimates to $0.68 a share from $0.75, pending a discussion with management.
-- The lower estimate reflects a sales shortfall and continued gross margin pressure related to expected January clearance sales, Piper said.
-- It said product transitions and clearance markdowns may affect furture quarters due to above-plan inventories.
-- Nordstrom's share price dropped 2-3/8 to 35-1/8 in morning trading.
